"""Selected nighttime parking capture entrypoint.

An original reviewed site packet is mandatory for Native execution. The CPU
check validates the selected request and never substitutes a synthetic site.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from night_parking_construction import plan_case, validate_site

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ASSIGNMENT = "testing__C229435__LVMC-11-52-300__horse_drawn_vehicle_operator"


def selected_config():
    value = json.loads((ROOT / "config.json").read_text())
    if (value.get("assignment_id") != ASSIGNMENT
            or value.get("law_id") != "LVMC-11-52-300"
            or value.get("cell_id") != "C229435"
            or value.get("actor") != "horse_drawn_vehicle_operator"
            or value.get("rate_hz") != 20
            or value.get("duration_s") != 1805.05
            or value.get("capture_queue_capacity") not in (4, 16)
            or value.get("selected_case_id") not in value.get("supported_case_ids", [])):
        raise ValueError("selected nighttime parking contract differs")
    request = value.get("case", {})
    if request.get("case_id") != value["selected_case_id"]:
        raise ValueError("selected case request differs")
    if request.get("design", {}).get("other_vehicle") != "present; original body and state required":
        raise ValueError("second vehicle construction required")
    return value


def reviewed_plan(value):
    root = os.environ.get("C229435_SITE_ROOT")
    if not root:
        raise ValueError("C229435_SITE_ROOT reviewed original site directory required")
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    packet_path = root / (value["selected_case_id"].rsplit("__", 1)[-1] + ".json")
    packet = validate_site(packet_path, root)
    return packet_path, packet, plan_case(value["case"], packet)


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    value = selected_config()
    if args.check:
        print(json.dumps({"case_id": value["selected_case_id"],
                          "capture_contract_checked": True,
                          "reviewed_original_site_required_for_native": True}))
        return 0
    if not args.output_dir:
        parser.error("--output-dir required")
    packet_path, packet, construction = reviewed_plan(value)
    from night_parking_native import run_native
    run_native(value, packet_path, packet, construction, Path(args.output_dir), args.host, args.port)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Source-gated physical construction of a street parking episode.

The reviewed packet is an external original site/vehicle dossier. A package
cannot turn an actor name or a car blueprint into proof of a horse-drawn vehicle.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
import datetime as dt
from pathlib import Path

FPS = 20
VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _inside(point, polygon):
    x, y = point
    odd = False
    for a, b in zip(polygon, polygon[1:] + polygon[:1]):
        if (a[1] > y) != (b[1] > y):
            crossing = a[0] + (y - a[1]) * (b[0] - a[0]) / (b[1] - a[1])
            if x < crossing:
                odd = not odd
    return odd


def _point(value, label):
    if not isinstance(value, list) or len(value) != 2 or not all(type(x) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(x) for x in value):
        raise ValueError(label + " needs finite XY coordinates")
    return value


def _polygon(value, label):
    if not isinstance(value, list) or len(value) < 3:
        raise ValueError(label + " needs three or more vertices")
    for point in value:
        _point(point, label)
    if len({tuple(point) for point in value}) < 3:
        raise ValueError(label + " is degenerate")
    return value


def _source(root, item, label):
    if not isinstance(item, dict) or not isinstance(item.get("path"), str) or not isinstance(item.get("sha256"), str):
        raise ValueError(label + " needs source path and SHA256")
    rel = Path(item["path"])
    if rel.is_absolute() or ".." in rel.parts:
        raise ValueError(label + " path escapes source root")
    path = root / rel
    if not path.is_file() or _sha(path) != item["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError(label + " original source hash mismatch")
    return path


def validate_site(packet_path, source_root):
    packet_path = Path(packet_path)
    root = Path(source_root)
    packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_text())
    if packet.get("format") != "night-parking-reviewed-site-v1":
        raise ValueError("reviewed site format required")
    sources = packet.get("sources")
    for label in ("opendrive", "municipal_boundary", "street_status", "vehicle_build", "person_activity"):
        _source(root, sources.get(label) if isinstance(sources, dict) else None, label)
    if not packet.get("native_map_name") or not packet.get("native_opendrive_sha256"):
        raise ValueError("Native map identity required")
    if packet["native_opendrive_sha256"] != sources["opendrive"]["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("OpenDRIVE map hash conflicts with reviewed source")
    geometry = packet.get("geometry", {})
    street = _polygon(geometry.get("street_polygon_xy_m"), "street")
    city = _polygon(geometry.get("municipal_polygon_xy_m"), "municipality")
    carriage = _point(geometry.get("carriage_park_xy_m"), "carriage location")
    other = _point(geometry.get("other_vehicle_xy_m"), "other vehicle location")
    if not all(_inside(point, street) and _inside(point, city) for point in (carriage, other)):
        raise ValueError("both vehicles need original street and city placement")
    if carriage == other:
        raise ValueError("vehicles overlap at center")
    if not geometry.get("carriage_body_dimensions_m") or not geometry.get("other_vehicle_body_dimensions_m"):
        raise ValueError("both physical body dimensions required")
    source_review = packet.get("source_review", {})
    for label in ("carriage_transport_capable", "carriage_motive_power", "vehicle_exclusions", "responsible_person", "street_public_access", "municipal_jurisdiction"):
        if not source_review.get(label):
            raise ValueError("missing independent source review: " + label)
    native = packet.get("native_actors", {})
    for label in ("carriage_blueprint", "other_vehicle_blueprint", "responsible_person_blueprint"):
        if not native.get(label):
            raise ValueError("missing Native actor blueprint: " + label)
    if native["carriage_blueprint"] == native["other_vehicle_blueprint"] and not native.get("carriage_physical_customization_source"):
        raise ValueError("carriage needs physical differentiation and provenance")
    try:
        dt.date.fromisoformat(packet["civil_date"])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
        raise ValueError("reviewed civil date required") from error
    _point(geometry.get("responsible_person_xy_m"), "responsible person placement")
    classification = packet.get("classification")
    if not isinstance(classification, dict) or not all(type(classification.get(key)) is bool for key in
            ("transport_capable", "self_propelled", "vehicle_exclusions_checked")):
        raise ValueError("reviewed vehicle physical classification required")
    return packet


def plan_case(case, packet):
    design = case["design"]
    if design["duration_s"] < 0 or design["duration_s"] > 3600:
        raise ValueError("unbounded parking duration")
    duration = design["duration_s"]
    # Fixed 1805 s physical window isolates parked duration while retaining
    # 2 s before and at least 2 s after the 1801 s longest episode.
    frames = round(1805 * FPS) + 1
    parked_first_index = 2 * FPS
    parked_last_index = parked_first_index + round(duration * FPS)
    if frames < 2:
        raise ValueError("parking episode needs at least two frames")
    return {
        "case_id": case["case_id"],
        "site_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(packet, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
        "native_map_name": packet["native_map_name"],
        "native_opendrive_sha256": packet["native_opendrive_sha256"],
        "fps": FPS,
        "duration_s": duration,
        "capture_duration_s": frames / FPS,
        "original_frame_count": frames,
        "parked_first_index": parked_first_index,
        "parked_last_index": parked_last_index,
        "civil_start_local_request": design["start_local"],
        "vehicle_class_request": design["vehicle_class"],
        "activity_request": design["purpose"],
        "carriage_park_xy_m": packet["geometry"]["carriage_park_xy_m"],
        "other_vehicle_xy_m": packet["geometry"]["other_vehicle_xy_m"],
        "cameras": list(VIEWS),
        "required_saved_sources": ["four_synchronized_original_video_streams", "frame_map", "original_actors", "reviewed_site", "classification", "activity_events", "civil_clock"],
        "legal_outcome_request": None,
    }

"""Original 20 Hz Native tick capture for both parking-cell vehicles."""
from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo


def utc_start(civil_date, local_time, zone="America/Los_Angeles"):
    value = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(civil_date + "T" + local_time)
    if value.tzinfo is not None:
        raise ValueError("reviewed civil date/time must be local naive fields")
    return value.replace(tzinfo=ZoneInfo(zone)).astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)


def _body(actor):
    vertices = actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(actor.get_transform())
    body = [[float(vertex.x), float(vertex.y)] for vertex in vertices]
    if len(body) < 4 or any(not math.isfinite(value) for point in body for value in point):
        raise ValueError("original complete Native body unavailable")
    return body


def _state(actor, *, parked=None, on_street=None):
    transform = actor.get_transform()
    velocity = actor.get_velocity()
    result = {
        "body_vertices_xy_m": _body(actor),
        "center_xy_m": [float(transform.location.x), float(transform.location.y)],
        "speed_m_s": math.sqrt(velocity.x ** 2 + velocity.y ** 2 + velocity.z ** 2),
    }
    if parked is not None:
        result.update(parked=bool(parked), on_street=bool(on_street))
    return result


def capture_ticks(world, subject, other, pipeline, cameras, frame_map, output,
                  *, frame_count, civil_start_utc, subject_on_street, subject_parked,
                  diagnostic=False):
    """Retain every world tick, original body and exact video frame identity.

    `subject_on_street` must inspect the current world body against the reviewed
    street polygon. `diagnostic` permits a small fake CPU fixture only.
    """
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    if ".runtime-work" not in output.parts or not output.is_dir():
        raise ValueError("original acquisition must stay under .runtime-work")
    if type(frame_count) is not int or frame_count < 2:
        raise ValueError("full episode needs at least two 20 Hz ticks")
    if not diagnostic and frame_count < 35981:
        raise ValueError("full nighttime duration construction is incomplete")
    if civil_start_utc.tzinfo is None:
        raise ValueError("reviewed civil UTC start required")
    first_time = None
    prior_frame = None
    previous_sim_time = None
    with (output / "night-parking-trace.jsonl").open("x", buffering=1) as details, \
         (output / "trace.jsonl").open("x", buffering=1) as generic:
        for index in range(frame_count):
            native_frame = world.tick()
            snap = world.get_snapshot()
            if type(native_frame) is not int or snap.frame != native_frame or (prior_frame is not None and native_frame != prior_frame + 1):
                raise ValueError("Native world tick identity discontinuity")
            native_time = float(snap.timestamp.elapsed_seconds)
            if not math.isfinite(native_time) or (previous_sim_time is not None and not math.isclose(native_time - previous_sim_time, .05, abs_tol=.001)):
                raise ValueError("Native world did not advance at 20 Hz")
            if first_time is None:
                first_time = native_time
            previous_sim_time = native_time
            prior_frame = native_frame
            subject_state = _state(subject, parked=subject_parked(index, subject),
                                   on_street=subject_on_street(subject))
            other_state = _state(other)
            civil_time = civil_start_utc + dt.timedelta(seconds=index / 20)
            detail = {"frame": native_frame, "utc_time": civil_time.isoformat(),
                      "subject": subject_state, "other_vehicle": other_state}
            details.write(json.dumps(detail, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            position = subject.get_transform().location
            generic.write(json.dumps({"frame": native_frame, "time_s": native_time - first_time,
                                      "position": {"x": float(position.x), "y": float(position.y), "z": float(position.z)},
                                      "heading_deg": float(subject.get_transform().rotation.yaw),
                                      "speed_mps": subject_state["speed_m_s"]}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
            frame_map.append(native_frame, native_time - first_time)
            pipeline.capture(native_frame, native_time)
            cameras.append(native_frame)
    return {"frames": frame_count, "first_native_frame": prior_frame - frame_count + 1,
            "last_native_frame": prior_frame, "civil_start_utc": civil_start_utc.isoformat(),
            "civil_end_utc": (civil_start_utc + dt.timedelta(seconds=(frame_count - 1) / 20)).isoformat(),
            "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}

"""Original Native four-view acquisition for the reviewed nighttime site.

The reviewed packet supplies physical carriage and person blueprints. This
module does not accept the assignment actor label as vehicle classification.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
import math
import queue
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from night_parking_capture import capture_ticks, utc_start
from night_parking_construction import _inside


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _write(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


class Cameras:
    SPECS = (("overview", 1920, 1080), ("approach", 1280, 720),
             ("reference_corner", 1280, 720), ("driver_reference", 1280, 720))

    def __init__(self, world, carla, subject, target, output, queue_capacity=4):
        if type(queue_capacity) is not int or not 1 <= queue_capacity <= 16:
            raise ValueError("bounded original camera queue capacity required")
        self.sensors = []
        self.encoders = {}
        self.queues = {}
        self.errors = []
        try:
            poses = ((-16, -14, 27, -55), (-24, -4, 10, -20),
                     (2, -9, 9, -35), (0, 0, 2, 0))
            for (name, width, height), (dx, dy, z, pitch) in zip(self.SPECS, poses):
                bp = world.get_blueprint_library().find("sensor.camera.rgb")
                bp.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(width))
                bp.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(height))
                bp.set_attribute("fov", "90")
                attached = name == "driver_reference"
                point = (carla.Location(x=dx, y=dy, z=z) if attached else
                         carla.Location(x=target[0] + dx, y=target[1] + dy, z=z))
                sensor = world.spawn_actor(bp, carla.Transform(point, carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch)),
                                           attach_to=subject if attached else None)
                self.sensors.append(sensor)
                frames = queue.Queue(maxsize=queue_capacity)
                self.queues[name] = frames

                def receive(image, sink=frames, label=name):
                    try:
                        sink.put_nowait(image)
                    except queue.Full:
                        self.errors.append("camera queue overflow: " + label)

                sensor.listen(receive)
                command = ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-n",
                           "-f", "rawvideo", "-pixel_format", "bgra", "-video_size",
                           f"{width}x{height}", "-framerate", "20", "-i", "pipe:0",
                           "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", "-pix_fmt", "bgra", str(output / (name + ".mkv"))]
                self.encoders[name] = subprocess.Popen(command, stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                                                       stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        except BaseException:
            self.close()
            raise

    def append(self, frame):
        if self.errors:
            raise RuntimeError("; ".join(self.errors))
        for name, _, _ in self.SPECS:
            image = self.queues[name].get(timeout=15)
            if image.frame != frame:
                raise RuntimeError("camera frame differs from original world frame: " + name)
            self.encoders[name].stdin.write(image.raw_data)

    def close(self):
        failures = []
        for sensor in reversed(self.sensors):
            try:
                sensor.stop()
            except BaseException as error:
                failures.append(repr(error))
        for name, encoder in self.encoders.items():
            try:
                if encoder.stdin and not encoder.stdin.closed:
                    encoder.stdin.close()
                if encoder.wait(timeout=180) != 0:
                    failures.append("encoder failed: " + name)
            except BaseException as error:
                failures.append(repr(error))
        for sensor in reversed(self.sensors):
            try:
                sensor.destroy()
            except BaseException as error:
                failures.append(repr(error))
        self.sensors = []
        self.encoders = {}
        if failures:
            raise RuntimeError("; ".join(failures))


def _spawn(world, carla, blueprint, point, heading):
    waypoint = world.get_map().get_waypoint(carla.Location(x=point[0], y=point[1], z=0))
    if waypoint is None:
        raise ValueError("reviewed street placement absent in Native map")
    pose = carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=point[0], y=point[1],
                                          z=waypoint.transform.location.z + .5),
                           carla.Rotation(yaw=heading))
    actor = world.spawn_actor(world.get_blueprint_library().find(blueprint), pose)
    if actor.type_id != blueprint or math.dist(
            [actor.get_transform().location.x, actor.get_transform().location.y], point) > .5:
        raise ValueError("Native actor identity or placement differs from reviewed source")
    return actor


def run_native(config, packet_path, packet, plan, output, host, port):
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap, seal_capture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot, restore

    output = Path(output).resolve()
    if not output.is_dir() or ".runtime-work" not in output.parts:
        raise ValueError("retained Native attempt must be under .runtime-work")
    client = carla.Client(host, int(port))
    client.set_timeout(30)
    saved_world = snapshot(client)
    world = client.get_world()
    actors = []
    camera = pipeline = frame_map = None
    errors = []
    phase = "initializing"
    restored = False
    try:
        if (world.get_map().name != plan["native_map_name"] or
                hashlib.sha256(world.get_map().to_opendrive().encode()).hexdigest()
                != plan["native_opendrive_sha256"]):
            raise ValueError("Native OpenDRIVE differs from reviewed original")
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = .05
        settings.no_rendering_mode = False
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        geo = packet["geometry"]
        native = packet["native_actors"]
        heading = float(geo.get("carriage_heading_deg", 0))
        subject = _spawn(world, carla, native["carriage_blueprint"],
                         geo["carriage_park_xy_m"], heading)
        actors.append(subject)
        other = _spawn(world, carla, native["other_vehicle_blueprint"],
                       geo["other_vehicle_xy_m"], float(geo.get("other_heading_deg", 0)))
        actors.append(other)
        person_xy = geo.get("responsible_person_xy_m")
        if not isinstance(person_xy, list) or len(person_xy) != 2:
            raise ValueError("reviewed responsible person placement required")
        person = _spawn(world, carla, native["responsible_person_blueprint"], person_xy, 0)
        actors.append(person)
        classification = packet.get("classification", {})
        if (not all(type(classification.get(key)) is bool for key in
                    ("transport_capable", "self_propelled", "vehicle_exclusions_checked"))
                or classification["self_propelled"] != (config["case"]["design"]["vehicle_class"] == "motor")):
            raise ValueError("reviewed carriage classification differs from selected case")
        classification = dict(classification, physical_source=packet["sources"]["vehicle_build"]["sha256"])
        context = {"iana_timezone": "America/Los_Angeles",
                   "municipal_jurisdiction_source": packet["sources"]["municipal_boundary"]["sha256"],
                   "street_source": packet["sources"]["street_status"]["sha256"],
                   "reviewed_site_sha256": _sha(packet_path), "subject_actor_id": subject.id,
                   "other_vehicle_actor_id": other.id, "responsible_person_actor_id": person.id}
        _write(output / "context.json", context)
        _write(output / "classification.json", classification)
        _write(output / "acquisition-provenance.json", {
            "provenance_kind": "native", "diagnostic_fixture": False,
            "method": "reviewed original CARLA live run"})
        camera = Cameras(world, carla, subject, geo["carriage_park_xy_m"], output,
                         queue_capacity=config.get("capture_queue_capacity", 4))
        pipeline = PipelineCapture(client, subject, output, config["selected_case_id"])
        frame_map = FrameMap(output / "video_frames.jsonl")
        start = utc_start(packet["civil_date"], plan["civil_start_local_request"]) - dt.timedelta(seconds=2)
        street = geo["street_polygon_xy_m"]
        first, last = plan["parked_first_index"], plan["parked_last_index"]
        phase = "capturing"
        receipt = capture_ticks(world, subject, other, pipeline, camera, frame_map, output,
                                frame_count=plan["original_frame_count"], civil_start_utc=start,
                                subject_on_street=lambda actor: all(_inside(
                                    [float(vertex.x), float(vertex.y)], street)
                                    for vertex in actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(actor.get_transform())),
                                subject_parked=lambda index, actor: first <= index <= last and
                                    math.sqrt(sum(getattr(actor.get_velocity(), axis) ** 2
                                                  for axis in ("x", "y", "z"))) <= .15)
        phase = "closing"
        pipeline.close(); pipeline = None
        frame_map.close(); frame_map = None
        camera.close(); camera = None
        activity = {"responsible_person_source": packet["sources"]["person_activity"]["sha256"],
                    "activity_source": "original responsible person and carriage acquisition",
                    "episode_start_event_source": "original selected 20 Hz schedule and body state",
                    "episode_end_event_source": "original selected 20 Hz schedule and body state",
                    "start_frame": receipt["first_native_frame"] + first,
                    "end_frame": receipt["first_native_frame"] + last,
                    "activity": config["case"]["design"]["purpose"]}
        _write(output / "activity.json", activity)
        names = {"context": "context.json", "classification": "classification.json",
                 "activity": "activity.json", "trace": "night-parking-trace.jsonl",
                 "frame_map": "video_frames.jsonl"}
        _write(output / "night-parking-sources.json", {
            "format": "night-parking-original-sources-v1",
            "sources": {key: {"path": name, "sha256": _sha(output / name)}
                        for key, name in names.items()}})
        originals = ["trace.jsonl", "night-parking-trace.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl",
                     "context.json", "classification.json", "activity.json",
                     "night-parking-sources.json", "road.xodr", "carla_recorder.log",
                     *[name + ".mkv" for name, _, _ in Cameras.SPECS]]
        _write(output / "acquisition.json", {name: {"kind": "original_native", "sha256": _sha(output / name)}
                                                for name in originals})
        phase = "sealed"
    except BaseException as error:
        errors.append(repr(error))
        raise
    finally:
        for resource in (pipeline, frame_map, camera):
            if resource is not None:
                try:
                    resource.close()
                except BaseException as error:
                    errors.append(repr(error))
        for actor in reversed(actors):
            try:
                actor.destroy()
            except BaseException as error:
                errors.append(repr(error))
        try:
            restored = restore(client, saved_world)["restored"]
        except BaseException as error:
            errors.append(repr(error))
        if phase == "sealed" and not errors and restored:
            seal_capture(output, frames=plan["original_frame_count"],
                         restoration={"restored": True,
                                      "settings_readback": "original world snapshot restored"},
                         errors=[], encoder_exit_codes={name: 0 for name, _, _ in Cameras.SPECS},
                         context={"night_parking": context, "episode_frames": [first, last]})
        else:
            _write(output / "native-run-status.json", {"phase": phase,
                  "errors": errors, "settings_restored": restored})
            if phase == "sealed":
                raise RuntimeError("Native cleanup or restoration failed")

"""Measure original parking episodes; leave statutory classification to review."""
from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

FPS = 20
NIGHT_START = dt.time(1, 0)
NIGHT_END = dt.time(6, 0)


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _read_sealed(path, expected_sha):
    if _sha(path) != expected_sha:
        raise ValueError("source SHA256 mismatch")
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def _local_midnight(day, tz):
    return dt.datetime.combine(day, dt.time(0), tzinfo=tz)


def night_overlap_seconds(start_utc, end_utc, zone):
    """Return measured intersection with each local 01:00–06:00 interval."""
    if start_utc.tzinfo is None or end_utc.tzinfo is None or end_utc <= start_utc:
        raise ValueError("ordered timezone-aware episode endpoints required")
    tz = ZoneInfo(zone)
    start_local = start_utc.astimezone(tz)
    end_local = end_utc.astimezone(tz)
    day = start_local.date() - dt.timedelta(days=1)
    last = end_local.date() + dt.timedelta(days=1)
    total = 0.0
    while day <= last:
        midnight = _local_midnight(day, tz)
        window_start = midnight.replace(hour=1).astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)
        window_end = midnight.replace(hour=6).astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)
        total += max(0.0, (min(end_utc, window_end) - max(start_utc, window_start)).total_seconds())
        day += dt.timedelta(days=1)
    return total


def measure(source_dir, contract):
    """Read hash-bound original frame/state and independent context sources."""
    source_dir = Path(source_dir)
    files = contract["sources"]
    context = _read_sealed(source_dir / files["context"]["path"], files["context"]["sha256"])
    classification = _read_sealed(source_dir / files["classification"]["path"], files["classification"]["sha256"])
    activity = _read_sealed(source_dir / files["activity"]["path"], files["activity"]["sha256"])
    trace_path = source_dir / files["trace"]["path"]
    if _sha(trace_path) != files["trace"]["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("original trace SHA256 mismatch")
    frame_map_path = source_dir / files["frame_map"]["path"]
    if _sha(frame_map_path) != files["frame_map"]["sha256"]:
        raise ValueError("original frame map SHA256 mismatch")
    if context.get("iana_timezone") != "America/Los_Angeles" or not context.get("municipal_jurisdiction_source") or not context.get("street_source"):
        raise ValueError("qualifying street and civil timezone sources required")
    if (not all(type(classification.get(key)) is bool for key in
                ("transport_capable", "self_propelled", "vehicle_exclusions_checked")) or
            not classification.get("physical_source")):
        raise ValueError("physical vehicle classification source required")
    if not activity.get("responsible_person_source") or not activity.get("activity_source"):
        raise ValueError("parking activity and responsible person sources required")
    frames = []
    with trace_path.open() as handle:
        for line in handle:
            frames.append(json.loads(line))
    with frame_map_path.open() as handle:
        mapping = [json.loads(line) for line in handle]
    if len(frames) < 2:
        raise ValueError("original frame history too short")
    if len(frames) != len(mapping):
        raise ValueError("original trace/frame count mismatch")
    prior_number = None
    prior_time = None
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        number = frame.get("frame")
        time = frame.get("utc_time")
        if type(number) is not int or not isinstance(time, str):
            raise ValueError("original frame/time identity required")
        instant = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(time.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        if instant.tzinfo is None:
            raise ValueError("UTC frame time must be timezone aware")
        instant = instant.astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)
        mapped = mapping[index]
        if (mapped.get("carla_frame") != number or mapped.get("video_frame") != index or
                type(mapped.get("time_s")) not in (int, float) or
                not math.isclose(mapped["time_s"] - mapping[0]["time_s"], index / FPS, abs_tol=.001)):
            raise ValueError("original video/frame/time join mismatch")
        if prior_number is not None:
            if number != prior_number + 1 or not math.isclose((instant - prior_time).total_seconds(), 1 / FPS, abs_tol=.001):
                raise ValueError("original 20 Hz frame/time discontinuity")
        for actor in ("subject", "other_vehicle"):
            body = frame.get(actor, {}).get("body_vertices_xy_m")
            if not isinstance(body, list) or len(body) < 4 or any(len(point) != 2 for point in body):
                raise ValueError(f"missing original {actor} body")
            if not all(math.isfinite(float(value)) for point in body for value in point):
                raise ValueError(f"nonfinite original {actor} body")
        if type(frame.get("subject", {}).get("on_street")) is not bool or type(frame.get("subject", {}).get("parked")) is not bool:
            raise ValueError("original street/parking state required")
        speed = frame["subject"].get("speed_m_s")
        if type(speed) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(speed) or speed < 0:
            raise ValueError("original body speed must be finite and nonnegative")
        prior_number = number
        prior_time = instant
    parked = [index for index, frame in enumerate(frames) if frame["subject"]["on_street"] and frame["subject"]["parked"]]
    if len(parked) < 2 or parked != list(range(parked[0], parked[-1] + 1)):
        raise ValueError("incomplete continuously parked street episode")
    episode = frames[parked[0]:parked[-1] + 1]
    if any(frame["subject"]["speed_m_s"] > .15 for frame in episode):
        raise ValueError("original parked body must have stationary engineering speed")
    start = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(episode[0]["utc_time"].replace("Z", "+00:00")).astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)
    end = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(episode[-1]["utc_time"].replace("Z", "+00:00")).astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)
    initial_body = episode[0]["subject"]["body_vertices_xy_m"]
    if any(max(math.dist(a, b) for a, b in zip(initial_body, frame["subject"]["body_vertices_xy_m"])) > .2 for frame in episode):
        raise ValueError("original parked body displaced beyond engineering stationary tolerance")
    if not activity.get("episode_start_event_source") or not activity.get("episode_end_event_source"):
        raise ValueError("independent parking boundary events required")
    # Endpoint events must correspond to retained original samples, not a narrated target.
    if activity.get("start_frame") != episode[0]["frame"] or activity.get("end_frame") != episode[-1]["frame"]:
        raise ValueError("episode event/frame join mismatch")
    elapsed = (end - start).total_seconds()
    return {
        "first_frame": episode[0]["frame"],
        "last_frame": episode[-1]["frame"],
        "frame_count": len(frames),
        "parked_frame_count": len(episode),
        "elapsed_s": elapsed,
        "night_overlap_s": night_overlap_seconds(start, end, context["iana_timezone"]),
        "start_local": start.astimezone(ZoneInfo(context["iana_timezone"])).isoformat(),
        "end_local": end.astimezone(ZoneInfo(context["iana_timezone"])).isoformat(),
        "subject_body_start_xy_m": initial_body,
        "subject_body_end_xy_m": episode[-1]["subject"]["body_vertices_xy_m"],
        "other_vehicle_body_start_xy_m": episode[0]["other_vehicle"]["body_vertices_xy_m"],
        "other_vehicle_body_end_xy_m": episode[-1]["other_vehicle"]["body_vertices_xy_m"],
        "transport_capable": classification["transport_capable"],
        "self_propelled": classification["self_propelled"],
        "vehicle_exclusions_checked": classification["vehicle_exclusions_checked"],
        "activity": activity.get("activity"),
        "source_hashes": {key: item["sha256"] for key, item in files.items()},
        "legal_conclusion": None,
        "uncertainty": "Statutory endpoint counting, qualification and parking purpose require independent review.",
    }

"""Saved-only LVMC 11.52.300 measurements from sealed original acquisition."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from night_parking_measurement import measure as source_measure


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def measure_night_parking(attempt):
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    source_manifest = attempt / "night-parking-sources.json"
    if not source_manifest.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Missing required source: night-parking-sources.json")
    manifest = json.loads(source_manifest.read_text())
    if manifest.get("format") != "night-parking-original-sources-v1":
        raise ValueError("wrong original parking source manifest")
    for item in manifest.get("sources", {}).values():
        path = attempt / item["path"]
        if not path.is_file():
            raise ValueError("Missing required source: " + item["path"])
    return source_measure(attempt, manifest)


def _recording_evidence(attempt, description, value):
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    channels = attempt / "channels"
    channels.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    source_manifest = json.loads((attempt / "night-parking-sources.json").read_text())
    original = [json.loads(line) for line in (attempt / source_manifest["sources"]["trace"]["path"]).read_text().splitlines()]
    streams = {
        "original_body_state": [row["subject"] for row in original],
        "other_vehicle_body_state": [row["other_vehicle"] for row in original],
        "civil_time": [row["utc_time"] for row in original],
        "vehicle_classification": [value["transport_capable"], value["self_propelled"], value["vehicle_exclusions_checked"]],
        "parking_activity": [value["activity"]],
        "street_jurisdiction": [value["start_local"], value["end_local"]],
    }
    evidence = []
    for channel in description["channels"]:
        name = channel["name"]
        if name not in streams:
            raise ValueError("unknown parking channel: " + name)
        path = channels / (name + ".jsonl")
        values = streams[name]
        with path.open("x") as handle:
            for index, row in enumerate(original):
                sample = values[index] if len(values) == len(original) else values
                handle.write(json.dumps({"time_s": index / 20, "value": sample}, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        evidence.append({"name": name, "unit": channel["unit"], "reference": str(path.relative_to(attempt))})
    context = {item["name"]: {"source_hashes": value["source_hashes"]} for item in description["context_inputs"]}
    if context:
        path = channels / "parking-context.json"
        path.write_text(json.dumps(context, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
        evidence.extend({"name": item["name"], "unit": item["unit"], "reference": str(path.relative_to(attempt))} for item in description["context_inputs"])
    return evidence


def finalize(attempt, output):
    attempt = Path(attempt)
    output = Path(output)
    config = json.loads((attempt / "config.json").read_text())
    construction = json.loads((attempt / "construction.json").read_text())
    case_id = config["selected_case_id"]
    if case_id != construction["case_id"]:
        raise ValueError("selected case differs from materialized construction")
    value = measure_night_parking(attempt)
    description = construction["recording_description"]
    evidence = _recording_evidence(attempt, description, value)
    requested = config["parking_duration_s"]
    matched = abs(value["elapsed_s"] - requested) <= .051
    source_set = dict(value["source_hashes"], **{"night-parking-sources.json": _sha(attempt / "night-parking-sources.json")})
    physical = {
        "status": "met" if matched else "not_met",
        "method": "sealed 20 Hz original body, event and civil-time episode measurement",
        "intervals": [{"first_frame": value["first_frame"], "last_frame": value["last_frame"]}],
        "sources": source_set,
        "legal_verdict_claimed": False,
        "physical_causation_claimed": False,
    }
    provenance = json.loads((attempt / "acquisition-provenance.json").read_text()) if (attempt / "acquisition-provenance.json").is_file() else {}
    kind = provenance.get("provenance_kind", "synthetic_fixture")
    result = {
        "case_id": case_id,
        "measured_values": value,
        "target_checks": [{"target": "continuous original street parking duration_s", "requested": requested,
                           "measured": value["elapsed_s"], "method": "original event/frame joined duration",
                           "tolerance": .051, "matched": matched,
                           "physical_cause_confirmed": False, "cause_evidence": source_set}],
        "setup_confirmed": matched,
        "behavior_attempted": matched,
        "maneuver_completed": matched,
        "termination_reason": "Saved original episode measured; legal and independent physical review pending",
        "physical_failure_flags": [],
        "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl",
        "video_references": ["overview.mkv", "approach.mkv", "reference_corner.mkv", "driver_reference.mkv"],
        "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
        "recording_description": description,
        "recording_evidence": evidence,
        "realized_observables": {},
        "physical_checks": {"setup": physical, "target": physical, "maneuver": physical},
        "provenance_kind": kind,
        "diagnostic_fixture": provenance.get("diagnostic_fixture", kind != "native"),
        "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
    }
    result_path = attempt / "result.json"
    if result_path.exists():
        raise ValueError("retained result exists; saved processing needs a fresh stage")
    result_path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    report = {
        "format": "worker-analysis-report", "case_id": case_id,
        "measurements": {"nighttime_parking_episode": {"value": value, "method": "measure_night_parking",
                                                   "sources": {**{item["path"]: item["sha256"] for item in json.loads((attempt / "night-parking-sources.json").read_text())["sources"].values()},
                                                               "night-parking-sources.json": _sha(attempt / "night-parking-sources.json")}}},
        "physical_checks": result["physical_checks"],
        "realized_observables": result["realized_observables"],
        "provenance_kind": kind,
        "diagnostic_fixture": result["diagnostic_fixture"],
        "limitations": ["No legal verdict, carriage classification acceptance, pixel acceptance or canonical delivery is claimed."],
        "analysis_complete": True,
        "legal_verdict_claimed": False,
    }
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    return report


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    finalize(args.attempt, args.output)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Independent source-bound audit of nighttime parking comparison isolation."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path


def _read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def _sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def _require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def audit(plan, comparison_id, attempts):
    plan = Path(plan)
    data = _read(plan)
    selected = next((item for item in data["comparisons"] if item["comparison_id"] == comparison_id), None)
    _require(selected is not None, "unknown exact comparison")
    _require(len(attempts) == 2, "comparison needs two original attempts")
    values = []
    result_hashes = {}
    for case_id, attempt in zip(selected["case_ids"], attempts):
        attempt = Path(attempt)
        path = attempt / "result.json"
        _require(path.is_file(), "missing saved exact result: " + case_id)
        result = _read(path)
        _require(result.get("case_id") == case_id, "wrong exact comparison case")
        _require(result.get("physical_acceptance_claimed") is False, "comparison cannot adopt an acceptance claim")
        measured = result.get("measured_values", {})
        for key in ("source_hashes", "subject_body_start_xy_m", "other_vehicle_body_start_xy_m", "elapsed_s", "night_overlap_s", "start_local", "end_local", "self_propelled", "activity"):
            _require(key in measured, "missing original comparison measurement: " + key)
        for name, checksum in measured["source_hashes"].items():
            _require(type(checksum) is str and len(checksum) == 64, "unbound original source hash: " + name)
        source_manifest = attempt / "night-parking-sources.json"
        _require(source_manifest.is_file(), "missing original source manifest")
        sources = _read(source_manifest)
        _require(sources.get("format") == "night-parking-original-sources-v1" and
                 set(sources.get("sources", {})) == set(measured["source_hashes"]),
                 "original source inventory differs from saved measurement")
        for name, descriptor in sources["sources"].items():
            relative = Path(descriptor["path"])
            _require(not relative.is_absolute() and ".." not in relative.parts, "original source path escapes attempt")
            original = attempt / relative
            _require(original.is_file() and _sha(original) == descriptor["sha256"] == measured["source_hashes"][name],
                     "stale original comparison source: " + name)
        values.append(measured)
        result_hashes[case_id] = _sha(path)
    left, right = values
    _require(left["source_hashes"].get("context") == right["source_hashes"].get("context"), "qualifying street/timezone context changed")
    _require(left["subject_body_start_xy_m"] == right["subject_body_start_xy_m"] and
             left["other_vehicle_body_start_xy_m"] == right["other_vehicle_body_start_xy_m"],
             "physical vehicle placement changed")
    if comparison_id != "nonmotor_exception":
        _require(left["source_hashes"].get("classification") == right["source_hashes"].get("classification"), "vehicle classification changed outside exception comparison")
    if comparison_id != "parking_vs_loading":
        _require(left["source_hashes"].get("activity") == right["source_hashes"].get("activity"), "parking activity source changed outside activity comparison")
    if comparison_id.startswith("duration_"):
        _require(left["start_local"] == right["start_local"], "duration comparison changed start civil time")
        _require(left["elapsed_s"] != right["elapsed_s"], "duration comparison did not vary measured duration")
    elif comparison_id == "night_vs_day":
        _require(left["elapsed_s"] == right["elapsed_s"], "clock comparison changed parked duration")
        _require(left["night_overlap_s"] != right["night_overlap_s"], "clock comparison did not vary measured nighttime overlap")
    elif comparison_id.startswith("one_am_"):
        pair = (left["start_local"][11:19], right["start_local"][11:19])
        expected = ("00:59:59", "01:00:00") if comparison_id == "one_am_below_at" else ("01:00:00", "01:00:01")
        _require(left["elapsed_s"] == right["elapsed_s"] and pair == expected,
                 "01:00 endpoint comparison changed parked duration or exact endpoint probes")
    elif comparison_id.startswith("six_am_"):
        pair = (left["end_local"][11:19], right["end_local"][11:19])
        expected = ("05:59:59", "06:00:00") if comparison_id == "six_am_below_at" else ("06:00:00", "06:00:01")
        _require(left["elapsed_s"] == right["elapsed_s"] and pair == expected,
                 "06:00 endpoint comparison changed parked duration or exact endpoint probes")
    elif comparison_id == "nonmotor_exception":
        _require(left["elapsed_s"] == right["elapsed_s"] and left["start_local"] == right["start_local"], "vehicle exception comparison changed episode timing")
        _require(left["self_propelled"] != right["self_propelled"], "vehicle exception comparison did not vary motive power")
    elif comparison_id == "parking_vs_loading":
        _require(left["elapsed_s"] == right["elapsed_s"] and left["start_local"] == right["start_local"], "activity comparison changed episode timing")
        _require(left["activity"] != right["activity"], "activity comparison did not vary actual activity")
    return {"format": "worker-comparison-audit", "comparison_id": comparison_id,
            "case_ids": selected["case_ids"], "result_sha256": result_hashes,
            "fixed_conditions_checked": selected["fixed_conditions"],
            "deliberate_differences_checked": selected["deliberate_differences"],
            "passed": True, "legal_verdict_claimed": False, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--plan", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--comparison", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--left", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--right", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    receipt = audit(args.plan, args.comparison, [args.left, args.right])
    Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
